fusions.name: Alarm Musk
fusions.desc: Releases a burst of musk that deals 11 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them 2.5 tiles back and leaves them [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Take the Bitterness
fusions.desc: Kicks an enemy and deals 8 poison damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaken Clean
fusions.desc: Removes 2 harmful conditions from you, then your movement speed rises by 30% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bezoar
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. You resist poison damage by 10%.
